title: Third Station: Jesus Falls the First Time
text:
Consider this first fall of Jesus under His Cross. His flesh was torn by His scourges, His head crowned with thorns, and He had lost a great deal of blood. He was so weakened that He could scarcely walk, and yet He had to carry this great weight
upon His shoulders. The soldiers struck Him rudely, and thus He
fell several times on His journey.



My Jesus, it is not the weight of the Cross, but of my sins, which has made Thee suffer so much pain. Ah, by the merits of this first fall, deliver me from ever falling into grave sin. I love Thee, my Jesus; I love Thee more than myself; I am sorry for having offended Thee. Never let me stray from Thee again. Grant that I may always love Thee and do Thy will. Amen.
notes: Text as distributed in the 'Catholic Prayers' Android app (richarddean.angeles.catholicprayers).
